interpreted_intent: Independently test the supplied portrait as visible adult appearance guidance in a separately randomized complex photorealistic scene, following the established three-arm method.
subject: one unmistakably adult woman with face and hair appearance guided by the supplied portrait
setting: a small restaurant with a front glass window just before dawn
event: she paints the last loop of the word TODAY on the interior window menu
visual_priorities: visible adult face and hair appearance guided by the reference portrait
legible hand-to-marker-to-glass contact and wet paint deposition
separate transparent street view and weaker indoor reflection on the same pane
coherent cool and warm light on skin, paint, and sill
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph inside a small restaurant just before dawn. An unmistakably adult woman is hand lettering the day's menu on the interior surface of the front glass window. Use the supplied portrait only as guidance for her visible adult facial appearance and hair: a chin-length black bob with a soft wispy fringe, dark eyes, softly rounded facial features, and natural lips. She is a new subject in a different setting, wearing a practical dark apron over a loose pale shirt. Keep her face unobstructed and her expression quietly intent. She stands close to the window on the restaurant side. Her right hand holds a white paint marker; the nib touches the glass at shoulder height and a fresh opaque stroke continues from its tip into the final loop of the large hand-lettered word TODAY. Her right elbow remains slightly bent and visible from shoulder to wrist. Her left hand rests on the deep wooden sill below at waist height, with the cloth for wiping the pane folded beside it. The painted letters occupy the left side of the pane while her face remains clear on the right. From this interior viewpoint the letters are meant for customers inside to read. Frame the woman from mid-thigh upward with her face, both hands, the marker contact point, the word, and the window in one view. Through the transparent unpainted glass, a quiet blue pre-sunrise street and parked bicycle remain visible; a warm pendant lamp inside the restaurant appears as a weaker reflection layered on the pane. Cool transmitted daylight shapes one side of her face while the warmer lamp grazes the marker and fresh paint. The white paint sits on the near glass surface with a slightly raised wet edge. A soft, directionally coherent shadow from her arm falls across the wooden sill. Preserve natural skin texture, small cleaning streaks near the bottom of the pane, realistic glass transmission and reflection, and a restrained documentary mood.
